Locators are printed page numbers. Loaded: membrane cell electricity and caustic-evaporation steam (Tables 3.9 and 3.11, plant medians with min-max), the new-plant cost (p.138) and the ODC emerging technique (s.6.2). Plant data are Euro Chlor 2010 surveys (reference years 2008-2010); the BREF compiles them, so the via-source is Euro Chlor. Not loaded: mercury and diaphragm cells (being phased out; no archetype), mercury-conversion costs (Tables 4.4-4.6, a conversion not a new plant), emissions. The sodium chlorate process is not in this BREF (see LVIC-S).
(1) Table 3.9 energy is AC per t Cl2; Table 3.11 steam is per t NaOH (100 %), a different product basis. (2) Currency years are not printed for the cost figures.
